source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 761 retains the requested URI for HTTP 302 and 307 while using the response URI for other statuses. The address that supplies the content during a temporary redirect need not be the stable subscription address. The new test asserts that the 302 calendar URI equals the original redirect URL. It does not cover 307, 301 or every redirect class, and no network subscription was performed during this study.
title: Subscribe to the original ICS address after a temporary redirect
